doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Armed services still segregated when he left
summary: Armed forces were not integrated until Truman's presidency.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Oh, oh, there was something -- let me just go back to the Air Force for one minute 'cause there was one thing I forgot to ask you when we took the break. When you left the Air Force, the Armed Services still, at that point, were not integrated?
Oh, no, listen, I was discharged, I mean, they didn't become integrated for a few years. Not till Truman was president.
When I went in, Roosevelt was president and he died while I was in the service, I think. Yeah.
Yeah. That's what I thought 'cause when you said '46, I knew it wasn't until a little bit later on, but I just wanted to make sure.
